name: Claude plugin manifest in the project
description: A .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest declares a plugin, reported wherever it sits in the tree. Claude Code loads one under .claude/skills/<name>/ as a skills-directory plugin, on the manifest's own defaultEnabled and after workspace trust, from the session's primary working directory. A manifest elsewhere depends on a companion chain in settings, extraKnownMarketplaces and enabledPlugins, that this scan does not read, so what is reported here is the manifest's presence rather than its reachability. A plugin that loads registers its hooks and adds its bin/ directory to the Bash tool's PATH, independent of every individual component this scan also reports separately. The MCP servers it declares take the per-server approval a project .mcp.json takes, so the manifest does not start them on its own. name is guaranteed non-empty by the adapter, which falls back to the plugin root's directory basename when the manifest omits it.
message: A plugin that loads registers its hooks and puts its bin/ files on the Bash tool's PATH; its MCP servers are approved per server
